app.title: Card Game App
app.subtitle: A modern card arena with local ranking, sound and premium animations.

home.headline: Enter a cinematic card battle
home.description: Register with a nickname, challenge the CPU and climb the local ranking while the deck decides your fate.

onboarding.title: How to play
onboarding.objective: Win more cards than the CPU before the deck runs out.
onboarding.turn: Draw one card for you and one for the CPU. The higher card wins the hand.
onboarding.tie: Ties add cards to the pot. The next winning hand collects those cards.
onboarding.ranking: Ranking stays only on this device and browser. It is not shared online.

footer.tagline: Professional demo project deployed on GitHub Pages.
footer.repositoryAria: Open Card Game App repository on GitHub

game.error: We could not connect to the deck. Try again.

guidance.nextStart: start a new game to prepare the deck
guidance.nextDraw: draw cards to play the next hand
guidance.nextError: start a new game to try again

ranking.title: Local ranking
ranking.description: Saved only in this browser. It is not an online leaderboard and is not shared across devices.
ranking.emptyDescription: Play a match to open the ranking.
ranking.clearWarning: This removes saved results from this device only.
